title: Before the Stand-up

pre.en: Why did nobody else join the video call?
pre.zh: 为什么视频会议上一直没有别人进来？
options: The stand-up starts at ten on Mondays.
Chen had joined the wrong call.
Everyone was busy fixing the old bug.

intro: 小陈讲自己站会前的一小时：煮咖啡、写清单、不开 Slack。可今天他「就看五分钟」一个老 bug，结果忘了时间。读的时候留意 enjoy、avoid、finish、keep、mind 这几个动词：后面跟的都是 doing，不是 to do。

sentences.en: So, our stand-up starts at half past nine, and the hour before it is my favourite part of the day.
sentences.zh: 我们的站会九点半开始，开会前那一个小时，是我一天里最喜欢的时候。

sentences.en: First thing in the morning, I make coffee while my flatmate Tom's still asleep, so I don't have to make small talk.
sentences.zh: 早上一起来，我先煮咖啡，这时候室友 Tom 还在睡，我也就不用跟人寒暄。

sentences.en: I also avoid opening Slack, because one message always turns into twenty.
sentences.zh: 我还尽量不开 Slack，因为一条消息总会变成二十条。

sentences.en: Instead, I enjoy writing a short to-do list on paper.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢在纸上写一张短短的待办清单。

sentences.en: I've done it every morning since I moved in.
sentences.zh: 从搬进来那天起，我每天早上都这么干。

sentences.en: I mean, I'd rather plan the day in advance than let Slack plan it for me.
sentences.zh: 说白了，我宁可自己提前把一天安排好，也不想让 Slack 替我安排。

sentences.en: This morning, I went through the list at a quarter past eight.
sentences.zh: 今天早上八点一刻，我把清单过了一遍。

sentences.en: Login screen, release notes — Rachel asked me to look after those — and a reply to Arjun.
sentences.zh: 登录页、发版说明——这个是 Rachel 让我负责的——还有回 Arjun 一条消息。

sentences.en: Then I had a quick look at an old bug, just for five minutes.
sentences.zh: 然后我去瞄了一眼一个老 bug，说好就看五分钟。

sentences.en: I wasn't even supposed to be working on it.
sentences.zh: 其实我压根就不该碰它。

sentences.en: But I kept trying one more idea, and then another.
sentences.zh: 可我老想着再试一个办法，试完又来一个。

sentences.en: Then I got distracted by a comment someone wrote back in 2019.
sentences.zh: 后来又被一行 2019 年留下的注释勾住了。

sentences.en: It said, "Don't touch this. Seriously."
sentences.zh: 上面写着：「别碰这里。我是认真的。」

sentences.en: So of course I touched it, and I completely lost track of time.
sentences.zh: 那我当然就碰了，然后完全忘了时间。

sentences.en: At 9:26, I looked up.
sentences.zh: 九点二十六，我才抬起头。

sentences.en: I finished writing my three-line update in a hurry and joined the call at 9:29.
sentences.zh: 我手忙脚乱地写完三行进度，九点二十九进了视频会议。

sentences.en: I was in a good mood, and I don't mind talking first.
sentences.zh: 我心情不错，第一个发言也无所谓。

sentences.en: "It's going to be a good day, isn't it?" I said to my screen.
sentences.zh: 「今天会很顺，对吧？」我对着屏幕说。

sentences.en: Nobody else joined.
sentences.zh: 可一直没有别人进来。

sentences.en: At 9:40, I finally opened Slack, and there it was.
sentences.zh: 九点四十，我终于打开 Slack，消息就躺在那儿。

sentences.en: A message from Rachel, sent at 8:30.
sentences.zh: Rachel 八点半发的：

sentences.en: "Stand-up cancelled today — my train's delayed. Enjoy the extra hour!"
sentences.zh: 「今天站会取消——我的火车晚点了。好好享受多出来的一小时吧！」

sentences.en: Too late, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 太晚啦，Rachel。

sentences.en: I'd already enjoyed it, with a bug from 2019.
sentences.zh: 这一小时我早就享受过了，陪着一个 2019 年的 bug。

cards.note: very early in the morning, before you do anything else
cards.tip: 整块用，first 前面不加 the；也常放句尾：I'll call you first thing tomorrow.
cards.example: I'll send you the report first thing in the morning.

cards.note: to have a polite conversation about unimportant things, especially with people you don't know well
make / write a to-do list；清单上的一项叫 item。
to start living in a new home
before a particular time or event
cards.tip: 说「提前多久」把时间放在前面：two days in advance；不说 in advance two days。
cards.example: Please send me the slides in advance so I can read them before the meeting.

cards.note: to look at or check something carefully from beginning to end
cards.tip: through 后面直接接要检查的东西：go through the list / your notes / the code；另一个常见意思是「经历（难事）」：go through a hard time。
cards.example: Let's go through the slides before the client arrives.

cards.note: App 每次更新时写给用户看的「这次改了什么」，总是用复数。
to take care of someone or something and keep them safe and well

cards.text: have a quick look at sth
cards.note: to look at something for a short time
cards.tip: 英式口语很常用，比 look at 随意；美式更常说 take a quick look。at 别丢：have a look at sth。
cards.example: Could you have a quick look at my email before I send it?

cards.note: used to say what someone should do because of a rule, a plan or what others expect
cards.tip: 否定 wasn't supposed to 是「本来不该」，常带点心虚：做了不该做的事。
cards.example: I'm supposed to send the build to QA by six, but it's still failing.

cards.note: to spend time doing, making or improving something
cards.tip: 代词放在 on 后面：work on it；问别人在忙什么就说 What are you working on?
cards.example: I'm working on the new sign-up screens this sprint.

cards.note: to stop paying attention to what you are doing because something else gets your interest
cards.tip: 被什么分心用 by：get distracted by the news。别说 I distracted（那是「我让别人分心」）。
cards.example: I get distracted when my phone is on the desk.

cards.note: 写代码时留给别人看的说明；平时也指评论：leave a comment。
单独一个词放在句尾，是加重语气：「我不是开玩笑」。也能当疑问：Seriously?（不会吧？）

cards.zh: 忘了时间；不知不觉过了很久
cards.note: to forget what time it is because you are busy or interested in something
cards.tip: track 在这里是「跟踪、掌握」；lose track of 后面还能接别的：lose track of the score（记不清比分了）。
cards.example: We were chatting so much that we lost track of time.

cards.note: doing something quickly because you do not have much time

cards.tip: 反过来是 be in a bad mood；mood 是一时的心情，不是性格。
cards.example: The boss is in a good mood today — ask her now.

cards.note: 英式拼写双写 l：cancelled、cancelling；美式是 canceled。
火车、航班晚点最常用 be delayed；晚了多久：delayed by 20 minutes。
